honesty_note: The Poissonnier 2026 open-arena outcomes and the frozen failures of H2-v1, H3-v1, and H4-v1 were known before H5 was drafted. Bonavita et al. 2026 Lasius niger search-behaviour results were also considered. This is outcome-aware mechanism design, not preregistration. The draft has been stress-tested but remains unfrozen, unimplemented, and ineligible for parameter search.
working_claim: Shorter recent constrained travel leaves a stronger area-restricted search tendency relative to the ant's trial origin. At ordinary major reorientation events, that tendency increases the probability of drawing a new direction from an origin-oriented circular distribution. Longer constrained travel weakens that search component and permits more direct outward dispersal. H5 does not directly change speed, global angular-noise magnitude, reorientation-event hazard, pause behavior, entry heading, or arena-edge/centerline attraction.

why_H5_is_substantively_different.H2: H2 changed the magnitude of spatially homogeneous continuous angular diffusion. H5 adds spatially contingent directional information relative to a trial origin.
why_H5_is_substantively_different.H3: H3 changed the timing/frequency of reorientation events while leaving conditional turn direction unbiased. H5 keeps the H3-null event timing law and changes only the conditional directional distribution at those events.
why_H5_is_substantively_different.H4: H4 changed moving speed only and left trajectory steering unchanged. H5 leaves moving speed unchanged and changes the distribution from which a post-reorientation direction is selected.
why_H5_is_substantively_different.H1: H1 is an entry-state explanation. H5 may use a shared measured or reconstructed trial origin as geometry, but may not assign treatment-specific entry heading, speed, position, or geometry distributions. Any measurement reconstruction must be frozen separately and applied identically to H5-null and H5-context.

poissonnier_control_pattern.straightness_path_length_effect: significant; short-path ants were less linear
poissonnier_control_pattern.moving_speed_path_length_effect: not statistically significant in the publication; short-path mean about 23.5 mm/s and long-path mean about 26 mm/s
poissonnier_control_pattern.interpretation: The strongest published signal is geometric: short-path ants wander farther and less linearly before reaching an edge. Speed-only H4 helped timing in some folds but did not generalize or solve spatial geometry.

frozen_internal_cv_history.H2: failed its frozen held-out promotion guard
frozen_internal_cv_history.interpretation: No spatially homogeneous one-primitive history effect generalized across colonies. H5 therefore tests spatial feedback rather than a stronger version of H2, H3, or H4.

Bonavita_et_al_2026.paper: Discovering search behaviour in black garden ant trajectories
Bonavita_et_al_2026.relevance: In Lasius niger released into an open arena, segment-level movement statistics depended on heading relative to the starting point, and simulations of those dependencies generated area-restricted search around the start.
Bonavita_et_al_2026.important_scope_limit: Those ants were passively transported/released in a different context. The paper supports origin-referenced search as a plausible representation, not the specific claim that 200 versus 1000 mm prior constrained walking modulates its strength in the Poissonnier assay.
Bonavita_et_al_2026.parameter_limit: The paper does not provide an independently validated single radial-scale parameter that can simply be imported as r_search_mm for H5.

Poissonnier_et_al_2026.relevance: Longer prior travel produced more linear subsequent walking while trail-following accuracy was unchanged, and Lasius niger can discriminate travel distances in this range.
Poissonnier_et_al_2026.scope_limit: This motivates a locomotion/search hypothesis but does not establish H5.

measurement_reconstruction_dependency.published_beeline_definition_verified: Beeline equals Euclidean distance from measured first tracked position (Xstart,Ystart) to measured final position (Xlast,Ylast) for all 51 DCM-control rows to floating-point tolerance.
measurement_reconstruction_dependency.current_simulator_mismatch: The current assay simulation uses nominal 297 x 210 mm A4 geometry and approximately 0.5 mm entry-position jitter around the geometric center. The published Beeline uses measured first-track coordinates and per-video tracked arena bounds, which vary from those nominal assumptions.

treatment_position_audit.interpretation: Measured start positions should not be ignored, but the available table does not provide compelling evidence for a treatment-specific start-position mechanism.

measurement_reconstruction_dependency.forbidden_resolution: Do not create separate short-versus-long entry-position or arena-geometry distributions merely because they improve H5 fit.
measurement_reconstruction_dependency.selected_resolution: For each LOCO fold, sample complete empirical geometry rows uniformly with replacement from the five training colonies only, pooled across path lengths, using the dedicated poissonnier2026_measurement_geometry_v1 input RNG stream. Apply the same geometry draws to short/long, null/context, and matched comparator re-evaluations.
measurement_reconstruction_dependency.measurement_vs_biology_boundary: first_track_position defines the observation start and Beeline start. The central entry reference represents the physical hole/trail crossing. This measurement policy does not decide which is the biological H5 search origin.

forbidden_inputs: reference metric values as direct model inputs
colony identity as a biological control input
pheromone presence or central-trail identity in the DCM H5 fit
identity of the eventual exit edge

candidate_mechanism.origin: Frozen O = the central physical entry-hole/trail-crossing reference supplied by the measurement geometry row (entry_reference_x_mm, entry_reference_y_mm). The simulated ant still begins observation at first_track_x_mm/first_track_y_mm. First-track position is not the biological H5 origin and may not be substituted after seeing model performance.
candidate_mechanism.history_search_drive: Temporal profile frozen constant during the observed arena traversal. The history-response magnitude D(L) remains provisional: current candidate D(L)=exp(-L/lambda_search_mm), so shorter recent constrained travel gives larger search drive, but its functional form and parameterization are not yet frozen. There is no tau_search_s and no elapsed-time decay in H5-v1.
candidate_mechanism.radial_gate: Provisional R(r) = r/(r+r_search_mm), where r = ||x-O||. Stress tests show baseline reorientation events span radii over which this gate is active, but r_search_mm remains provisional and potentially confounded with rho_search and lambda_search_mm.
candidate_mechanism.mixture_weight: Provisional w = rho_search * D(L) * R(r), constrained to [0,1].

reorientation_effect.baseline_component: Use the ordinary H3-null post-reorientation directional law and existing H3 turn-angle RNG stream.
reorientation_effect.search_component: Draw a direction symmetrically around the bearing from current position to O using a dedicated H5 search-angle stream. For the parsimonious v1 candidate, the pre-freeze default is to reuse the same concentration/dispersion parameter as the baseline reorientation family rather than introduce a separate search concentration.
reorientation_effect.mixture_rule: At each baseline major reorientation event, draw a dedicated H5 choice variate u. If u < w use the search component; otherwise use the already-drawn baseline component.
reorientation_effect.event_timing: The event time is generated entirely by the H3-null continuous-time event process. H5 does not alter event hazard or threshold integration.
reorientation_effect.antipodal_rule: When the origin is exactly behind the ant, H5 remains a symmetric mixture distribution and does not choose an arbitrary deterministic left-versus-right mean turn.
reorientation_effect.origin_rule: At r=0, set w=0. Any inert search-angle draw must not influence the selected baseline trajectory.

rng_candidate.cadence_rule: If this formulation is frozen, H5-null and H5-context should consume the dedicated H5 choice/search streams with matched cadence so model differences cannot be caused by unrelated RNG shifting. The existing H3 streams must remain untouched by H5 dedicated draws.

candidate_mechanism.speed: No direct moving-speed effect in H5-v1 draft.
candidate_mechanism.pause: No direct pause-hazard or pause-duration effect in H5-v1 draft.
candidate_mechanism.entry_state: No direct alteration of initial heading, initial speed, or initial position by H5 biology.

rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.name: signed_error_mean_shift
rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.reason: Real-Chromium stress testing exposed a circular branch-cut discontinuity at the antipodal configuration; infinitesimal heading perturbations can flip a large commanded turn from one side to the other.

rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.name: circular_vector_mean_blend
rejected_pre_freeze_formulations.reason: The vector resultant becomes degenerate for antipodal directions at a 50/50 blend and the selected mean direction jumps by approximately pi across that point.

candidate_baseline_family.preferred_representation: Reuse the already audited continuous-time run-and-reorientation machinery from H3 as a locomotion substrate with the H3 history-dependent hazard gate disabled. H5's history effect is solely the conditional directional mixture at baseline event times.
candidate_baseline_family.reason: This reuses audited sub-step event timing and separates H5's new biological claim from the failed H3 history-hazard claim.
candidate_baseline_family.warning: Reusing H3 event machinery is not a rescue of H3-v1. H3's history-dependent reorientation hazard remains failed and must stay disabled.

stress_tested_invariants_for_candidate_m: Rotation of both origin and trajectory frame leaves the directional mixture unchanged up to the same rotation.
Reflection around the outward axis produces a reflected distribution rather than an arbitrary preferred turn side.
Representing an antipodal origin bearing as +pi versus -pi does not create a material distribution discontinuity.
w=0 gives the exact baseline distribution.
r=0 gives w=0 and no origin singularity.
Translating an off-center synthetic origin translates the search reference; the rule does not remain tied to arena center.
Dedicated H5 choice/search RNG streams do not perturb the existing H3 turn-angle stream.
No H5 runtime implementation was used to obtain these stress results.
draft_structural_predictions: For matched baseline parameters and geometry, short-history ants should have a larger probability than long-history ants that a major reorientation is drawn from the origin-oriented component.
The treatment effect should depend jointly on current radial position relative to O and recent constrained travel, not merely on elapsed time.

Short-history ants should accumulate more path length and take longer to reach an arena edge primarily through origin-referenced search, without requiring a direct reduction in instantaneous moving speed.
Long-history ants should disperse outward more directly because the origin-oriented mixture component is weaker.
The origin-oriented component is rotationally symmetric around O and therefore predicts no intrinsic left/right/top/bottom exit preference in a symmetric arena.
H5 predicts no direct attraction to the DCM centerline; central-zone differences must emerge indirectly from geometry and trajectories.
With rho_search=0, H5-context must reduce exactly to H5-null for the same shared measurement geometry and matched baseline random streams.
If the provisional exponential D(L) is retained, the effect tends toward zero as recent_constrained_travel_mm becomes very large.

identifiability_warnings.history_levels: The development assay supplies only two history distances, 200 and 1000 mm. It cannot richly identify the shape of an arbitrary history-response curve.
identifiability_warnings.stress_result: Across deliberately broad engineering-only lambda values, the implied short-to-long mixture-weight ratio ranged from about 2.23 to 24.53 without changing the qualitative mechanism.
identifiability_warnings.radial_scale: Baseline H3-null reorientation events occur over a broad radial range, so a radial gate is mechanically meaningful, but rho_search, lambda_search_mm, and r_search_mm can trade off.
reporting_if_ever_fit: Effective mixture weight at L=200 and L=1000 for representative radii
Predicted number/proportion of origin-oriented reorientations under each observed history
Ridge or equivalence sets if raw parameters are broad
identifiability_warnings.claim_rule: Do not report a unique biological lambda_search_mm or r_search_mm unless the frozen estimator supplies strong identifiability evidence beyond merely selecting one candidate.

raw_trajectory_discriminators_if_recover: post-reorientation heading conditional on bearing to the trial origin
probability that a reorientation is origin-oriented as a function of radial distance
free-path length conditional on heading toward versus away from the trial origin
radial displacement from origin as a function of time
number and timing of returns toward the origin neighborhood
short-versus-long differences in those origin-referenced quantities
moving speed conditioned on radial heading, diagnostic only under the current movement-classifier firewall
negative_controls: No history-dependent change to global angular_sigma_rad_sqrt_s.
No history-dependent change to reorientation-event hazard.
No treatment-specific entry heading, entry speed, entry position, or arena-bound distribution.
No centerline, pheromone, exit-edge, or arena-boundary targeting.
No Y-maze access for development fitting, ranking, stopping, or model selection.
pre_freeze_questions: Should H5-v1 alter only the conditional reorientation-direction mixture, or also orientation-dependent free-path length as reported in the external Lasius representation? Current draft preference is direction only for parsimony until contradicted by reachability testing.
Should the radial gate be retained, simplified, or fixed from an independently justified rule? The external paper does not supply a directly transferable r_search_mm.

If D(L)=exp(-L/lambda_search_mm) is retained, should lambda be estimated at all or should H5 be parameterized directly by constrained effective weights at the two observed history distances? This is an identifiability decision, not a tuning decision.
What H5-null nuisance family and bounds are justified independently of H5 outcomes? They remain deliberately unspecified.
allowed_shared_measurement_or_geometry_i: first_tracked_position_mm (observation initialization and Beeline start only; not H5 biological origin)

biological_origin_decision.protocol_reason: The ant physically emerges through the central hole onto the arena. The first tracked coordinate is a later observation coordinate and remains the measurement/Beeline start only.
biological_origin_decision.representation_reason: Origin-referenced search should be tied to the physical trial start, not to an observer-dependent first-detected frame.
biological_origin_decision.first_track_position_role: observation initialization and published-style Beeline start only; forbidden as the H5 biological origin
biological_origin_decision.caveat: The observed simulation starts at the first tracked position, already displaced from the central origin. The short unobserved center-hole-to-first-track segment is not replayed. If a later H5 formulation introduces temporal decay, biological time zero and any unobserved delay must be resolved before freezing that decay law.

temporal_drive_decision.rule: For fixed recent_constrained_travel_mm L, the H5 history search drive does not decay with elapsed observed arena time. H5-v1 has no tau_search_s parameter.
temporal_drive_decision.reason: The biological origin is the central physical entry point but observation begins later at first_track_position. The elapsed center-hole-to-first-track interval is unobserved. A temporal decay would therefore introduce an unidentified pre-track time offset exactly confounded with decay amplitude; very slow decay approaches the constant model while adding a weakly identified parameter.
